implementation.name: Tecmo (Analogue Pocket, nullobject)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 58 HDL source files (47 verilog, 11 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this openFPGA core ships 7 MRA files of its own; 3 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 4 through MAME's own cloneof relation, giving 3 distinct machine_id rows. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING file at its root and no licence grant was found in the HDL headers read (quartus/apf/apf_top.v, quartus/apf/common.v, quartus/apf/io_bridge_peripheral.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 58 source files (47 verilog, 11 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/nullobject.tecmo/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier nullobject.tecmo.
